summary: Iteration 3 retest: TanStack route nesting bug FIXED. Backend regression: 19/19 pass. Frontend critical flow now works end-to-end: /admin list → click View → /admin/students/{uid} mounts StudentDetail (student-tabs + student-name visible), GET /api/admin/students/{uid} returns 200. Empty states (intake/photos/checkins) all render. Notes flow: POST /api/admin/notes returns 200, new note card renders with data-testid='note-{id}'. Direct URL nav to /admin/students/{uid} also mounts. Non-admin user redirected away. /products page mounts correctly (regression check passed for route rename); affiliate 'Shop this product' anchors only render when authenticated user has a personalized routine via completed intake — confirmed not a regression from this iteration's rename.

Route fix verification (routeTree.gen.ts): both AdminIndexRoute (line 58) and AdminStudentsUidRoute (line 68) now have getParentRoute: () => rootRouteImport — confirmed via grep. Clean fix.

Use page.context.clear_cookies() + indexedDB.deleteDatabase loop to log out between tests. The previously-blocked /admin/students/$uid route now correctly mounts; routeTree.gen.ts shows getParentRoute=>rootRouteImport for both admin routes.
rca of the issue: Bug fix verified. Root cause was TanStack file-based routing treating admin.students.$uid.tsx as a child of admin.tsx (which had no <Outlet/>). Fix: rename admin.tsx → admin.index.tsx (turning it into an index route under root) and regenerate routeTree.gen.ts — now both AdminIndexRoute and AdminStudentsUidRoute are direct children of rootRouteImport, so each mounts its own component without needing an intermediate Outlet. End-to-end retest confirms the detail page loads, calls /api/admin/students/{uid}, renders tabs + empty states + notes, and works via both link click and direct URL nav.
